name: Exporter for wBuy
author: Adriano Meira

sections.description:
The Exporter for wBuy plugin makes it easier to migrate WooCommerce stores to the wBuy platform.
It generates CSV files compatible with wBuy’s import templates, for both products and customers.

Main features:
– Export all registered WooCommerce products (simple and variable).
– Export customers.
– Output format ready for conversion and import into wBuy.
– Simple interface in the WordPress admin panel.

Note: files are generated in CSV. Before importing into wBuy, it is recommended to convert them to XLS.

Support

This plugin was developed to help migrate stores to the wBuy platform.
For questions about importing into wBuy, please contact n2@wbuy.com.br.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the exportador-wbuy directory to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. In the WordPress admin sidebar, go to Export wBuy to start exporting products or customers.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin also import data?

No. It only exports products and customers in the format accepted by wBuy.

Is the generated file XLS?

No. The plugin generates CSV, but wBuy requires XLS. Simply open the CSV in Excel/LibreOffice and save it as XLS before importing.

Does the plugin work without WooCommerce?

No. WooCommerce must be active for the plugin to work.
